title: Ntụkwasị Obi E Nyere n'Osimiri ahụ
intro: Mkpụrụ obi chere iwu na-agaghị ekwe omume ihu, ebe ndụ nwa amụrụ ọhụrụ nọ n'ọnọdụ kwụ ọtọ. Site n'ike mmụọ nsọ Chineke, e rubere iwu siri ike isi, e wee tinye ihe nzuzo dị oké ọnụ ahịa n'elu mmiri ozuzo ahụ, ma weghachite ya n'ụzọ a na-atụghị anya ya.
clues: Ebi m n'okpuru ndò onye ọchịchị aka ike nke nyere iwu ka e gbuo ụmụ nwoke amụrụ ọhụrụ.
Mmụọ nsọ Chineke bịakwutere m, na-agwa m ka m mee ihe dị egwu ma na-akpasu iwe.
Etinyere m nwa m dị oke ọnụ ahịa n'ime igbe ma tinye ya n'elu osimiri na-asọ asọ.
Obi m tọgbọ chakoo, ọ fọrọ obere ka m kpughee ihe nzuzo ahụ, mana Chineke mere ka mkpebi m sie ike.
E zigara m mmadụ ka ọ soro njem nwatakịrị ahụ na-agbada ebe mmiri na-agbapụta n'ime igbe ahụ.
Ezinụlọ onye ọchịchị aka ike ahụ chọtara nwatakịrị ahụ, n'ikpeazụ, mụ na nwa m laghachiri azụ wee bụrụ onye na-elekọta nwa.

trial.answer: O tinyere nwa ya n'ime igbe wee dọba ya n'akụkụ osimiri

location.answer: Igbe e tinyere n'elu osimiri ahụ

Onye ọchịchị aka ike gburu ya
Ọ kwagara ala ọzọ wee biri n'ala ọzọ
outcome.answer: E mechara zute ya na nwa ya ma nye ya ara

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
